decisions.reason: The source refines only the Hero V's right-arm length and silhouette; it does not resume or alter the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The existing requirement that the É accent derive from the Hero V geometry remains valid and dynamically refers to that geometry; the source does not establish a separate accent-specific change.
The existing shared-geometry relationship remains valid, while the source explicitly refines Option 1 of the Hero V and does not specify a separate construction change for the closing V.
The source changes the Hero V's geometry only and neither changes nor resumes the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
Extending the Hero V's right arm does not necessarily change the deferred wordmark kerning or cadence requirements, and the source gives no spacing instruction.
Although the source explains the intended refinement, it does not change the standing requirement for the freelancer to provide short design rationales with each round.
The Hero V geometry decision has no effect on the accepted formats or delivery methods for accessible review images.
